item: O-094 (CMP-H03) — Start-from-assembly presets, duplicate/mirror, bulk material changes, and reusable templates.

acceptance_text: Start-from-assembly presets, duplicate/mirror, bulk material changes, and reusable templates. (ESTIMATOR_MASTERPLAN.md:689 — terse CMP-H03 line; the four verbs map to the four deliverables below.)

contract_reading.patch_contract: prepareFoundationTemplatePatch(data, {createId, appliedAt}) is the single page-side apply gate: allowlist-clones the 31 template fields, sanitizes customer_pricing, stamps ai_engineering_data (O-007t) and notes (O-119), and clones supplied assembly arrays via cloneFoundationComponents — fresh component_ids (incl. nested wall segments + pole signs), remapped references, dependent index fields rebuilt. The page merges as commit(() => patch) = {...prev, ...patch}: supplied arrays REPLACE wholesale, absent keys PRESERVE. Every O-094 transform returns a patch honoring exactly those merge semantics ({patch, summary} wrappers — patch is the mergeable delta, summary is caller telemetry).
contract_reading.assembly_geometry: foundationAssemblyModel.js + foundationLayoutModel.js (READ-only): items = top-left plan corner x_inches/z_inches + unrotated footprint (foundationLayoutFootprint: length_inches x width_inches, or diameter x diameter for pillars) + visual rotation_degrees about the footprint center; poles = plan point x_inches/z_inches; walls = shape.points [{x,z}] with derived segment lengths (reflection/translation preserve them exactly — wallCalculator's 8*EPSILON geometry-mismatch check is structurally satisfied); wall_caps and signage_cabinets carry NO plan coordinates — they position by component_id reference (wall+segment / pole+foundation) and ride their parents through remapping.
contract_reading.material_fields: per-field applicability read from the remote panels: items selected_concrete_id (per-item mix override from catalog.concrete) + selected_forming_id + legacy selected_pole_id (advisory legacy item-pole field per poleCalculator — still a material id); walls materialId + internalMaterialId (two distinct material slots); poles pole_id; wall_caps cap_inventory_id; project scalar selected_concrete_id (default mix). signage_cabinets carry authored unit_cost — no catalog id, not a bulk target. project_concrete_type is a descriptive type string ('4000psi'), not a catalog id — not a bulk target. custom_concrete_cost_per_cy is a PRICE override — never authored, reported as advisory count.

exports.FOUNDATION_ASSEMBLY_PRESETS: 6 frozen named preset objects (single-spread-footing, single-pillar-pier, pylon-pole-on-pier, twin-pole-monument, monument-base-wall-cap, open-l-wall-run). Each project_data is snapshot-shaped (assembly_schema_version 1 + all 5 assembly arrays). Material-id fields authored blank — presets never carry catalog ids, prices, rates, customer fields, notes, or AI data. Wall segments carry canonical lengths from the REAL foundationWallSegments + authored component_ids so preset caps have referenceable segments.
exports.foundationAssemblyPresetTemplateData(pre: deep-cloned snapshot-shaped record for the dialog's existing onApply(data) lane — the page's prepare gate validates + remints + remaps exactly like a stored template
exports.describeFoundationAssemblyPreset(presetO: {preset_key, name, summary, counts, counts_label, total_components} row metadata for the pick list
exports.applyFoundationAssemblyPreset(project, p: {patch, summary}. mode 'replace' (default) routes through prepareFoundationTemplatePatch (start-from semantics — supplied arrays replace); mode 'append' clones preset rows onto the existing assembly via appendClonedFoundationAssemblies (collision-guarded ids, refs remapped inside clone set, indexes rebuilt vs merged arrays) and supplies only non-empty appended arrays.

exports.appendClonedFoundationAssemblies(project: shared clone+append engine: cloneFoundationComponents with a collision guard seeded from every existing id/ref, optional per-clone geometry transform, source_item_component_id lineage remap via idMap, deep-cloned existing rows, dependent index fields rebuilt against the FINAL merged arrays, patch supplies only arrays that gained rows
exports.duplicateFoundationAssembly(project, {co: {patch, summary{id_map, duplicated, rows_added}}. component_ids absent = whole assembly; explicit ids fail closed on unknown; dependent closure (pole-on-item, cap-on-wall, cabinet-on-pole/item, fixpointed) defaults on; refs pointing outside the clone set keep original ids (a duplicated cap stays on its kept wall); default 12in/12in plan offset on item+pole x/z and wall points
exports.mirrorFoundationAssembly(project, {compo: {patch, summary{axis, at, mirrored, rows_added|rows_mirrored}}. Mirror line: explicit at | foundation edge (edge_of item + min_x/max_x/min_z/max_z or left/right/top/bottom) | canvas centerline (240/160). mode 'copy' (default) appends reflected clones (createId required); mode 'reflect'/'in_place' reflects selected rows keeping ids — caps/cabinets ride refs so only geometry-carrying arrays enter the patch. Items reflect by footprint center (corner storage adjusted by width/depth) and flip rotation theta -> -theta (reflection reverses orientation on either axis); poles reflect as points; wall points reflect coordinate-wise with lengths preserved.

exports.FOUNDATION_BULK_MATERIAL_TARGETS: applicability catalog — concrete (items.selected_concrete_id + project selected_concrete_id), forming (items.selected_forming_id), wall_material (walls.materialId), internal_wall_material (walls.internalMaterialId — a separate slot, never conflated), wall_cap (wall_caps.cap_inventory_id), pole (poles.pole_id + legacy items.selected_pole_id). Unknown targets fail closed listing valid keys — no free-form field writes.
exports.applyFoundationBulkMaterial(project, {ta: {patch, summary}. modes 'all' (write every applicable slot in scope), 'replace' (only current === from), 'fill_blank' (only empty slots); value '' clears; component_ids scopes rows; project default participates under the same mode rules when the target defines one; patch supplies only changed arrays (+the project scalar when it moved); summary carries rows_changed per kind, fields_touched, project_default_changed, and custom_price_rows_kept advisory (custom concrete price overrides survive a mix swap — never repriced by this path).

ledger_paragraph: O-094 (CMP-H03) assembly-ops unit LOCAL-ONLY at remote HEAD 37d401b5a (clean worktree; all baselines fresh sandbox reads — never local src/). Three new pure modules: foundationDuplicateMirror.js (duplicateFoundationAssembly — select-all-or-by-id clone with dependent-closure, collision-guarded fresh ids, remapped refs incl. source_item_component_id lineage, default 12in plan offset; mirrorFoundationAssembly — copy clones or in-place reflect about explicit at / foundation edge_of+edge / canvas centerline, items by footprint center with rotation flipped theta->-theta, poles as points, wall points reflected with segment lengths preserved; shared appendClonedFoundationAssemblies engine rebuilds dependent indexes vs merged arrays), foundationAssemblyPresets.js (6 frozen named assembly presets as snapshot-shaped data — all 5 arrays supplied, blank material ids, never a price; foundationAssemblyPresetTemplateData feeds the dialog's existing onApply lane; applyFoundationAssemblyPreset replace = the real prepareFoundationTemplatePatch gate, append = collision-guarded clone splice), foundationBulkMaterialChange.js (FOUNDATION_BULK_MATERIAL_TARGETS applicability map — concrete/forming/wall/internal-wall/cap/pole slots incl. legacy selected_pole_id; applyFoundationBulkMaterial with all/replace/fill_blank modes, component_ids scope, project-default participation, custom-price advisory — never authors a price field). FoundationTemplateDialog.jsx gains the 'Start from an assembly preset' pick section (6 rows, counts, replace disclosure) above a preserved 'Saved templates' block — the fit-the-existing-dialog clause landed, and presets ride the identical onApply(data) -> prepareFoundationTemplatePatch -> commit lane as saved templates so reusable-template round-tripping needed zero page edits. All transforms return {patch, summary} where patch merges {...prev, ...patch} exactly like template patches — supplied arrays replace, absent keys preserve. Verified: 25/25 esbuild+react-test-renderer cases on candidates bundled against REAL baseline deps + 5/5 real-Chromium cases at 1280px/390px (preset rows, apply-through-real-gate readback, in-browser ops with exact numerics, zero foreign requests/console/page errors; screenshots). Deferred by file ownership, documented in SPEC: page commit() wiring + toolbar buttons for duplicate/mirror/bulk (selection plumbing accepts any component_ids array; absent = whole assembly). Not touched: FoundationEstimator.jsx, FoundationBOM.jsx, foundationCalc/foundationReinforcement*/partSync (Phase B-3), FoundationProject.jsonc/settings, recovery cluster (O-004t), inventory files, AI review channel, panels read for field contract only. No remote write/checkpoint/deploy/business records/paid AI.
